question: Aminoglycoside affects ?

options.opa: Outer hair cells in basal area
options.opb: Inner hair cells in basal area
options.opc: Outer hair cells in apical area
options.opd: Inner hair cells in apical area

analysis: Aminoglycosides are known to cause ototoxicity, primarily affecting the outer hair cells in the cochlea. The damage is most pronounced in the basal turn of the cochlea, which is responsible for high-frequency sound detection. This is why patients often experience high-frequency hearing loss first.
